configuration.name: offline_workload_aware_policy_selection
configuration.decision_scope: offline single-workload batch policy selection; no runtime switching

workload_families.name: short_jobs
workload_families.description: Short-job-heavy: 80% of bursts drawn from 1-5 time units.

workload_families.name: long_jobs
workload_families.description: Long-job-heavy: 20% of bursts drawn from 1-5 time units.

workload_families.name: mixed
workload_families.description: Uniform mix of bursts over the full 1-50 range.

workload_families.name: cpu_bursty
workload_families.description: Long CPU bursts (20-50) with dense uniform arrivals.

workload_families.name: priority_skewed
workload_families.description: Uniform bursts; 70% of priorities lie in the 1-2 band.

workload_families.name: staggered_interactive
workload_families.description: One long process at time zero plus 14 short processes arriving at integer gaps of 4-6 time units.

workload_families.name: poisson_arrivals
workload_families.description: Held-out evaluation condition: Poisson arrivals (rate 0.5) and uniform bursts from 1-20.

state.overflow_behavior: clamp into lowest or highest open-ended bin
state.index_order: first listed variable is most significant; mixed-radix flattening

reward.reference: arithmetic mean across the four policies on the identical workload

q_learning.gamma_effect_in_project: none: every workload episode is terminal
q_learning.unseen_state_behavior: all actions tie initially; np.argmax deterministically selects action 0 (FCFS); reported as an untrained fallback
q_learning.action_selection: epsilon-greedy; training samples uniformly from four actions with probability epsilon
q_learning.evaluation: greedy, deterministic, no Q-table or visit-count updates
